stack_slot_notation.definition: Sn = [ESP_entry + n*4] where ESP_entry is ESP at function entry (pointing at return address): S1=+0x4, S2=+0x8, S3=+0xC, S4=+0x10, S5=+0x14, S6=+0x18
stack_slot_notation.derivation: reads before pushes are direct; reads after k pushes are corrected by the 4*k byte shift (see claim P10-2 arithmetic)

claims.statement: Semantics = first-match linear scan over an array of 8-byte entries bounded by [S1,S2): main loop is a 4-way unrolled scan of 0x20-byte blocks (ECX = (S2-S1) SAR 5 = block count @0x00745A83-0x00745A8A; four checks per block at cursor+0/+8/+16/+24, cursor EAX advanced by ADD EAX,0x8 after each read block row), residual dispatch handles exactly 1, 2 or 3 remaining entries (ECX = ((S2-EAX)>>3)-1 then two more SUB 1 with JZ to 0x00745AF2 / 0x00745AE7 and JNZ to fail for count 0), byte value read is zero-extended (MOVZX) from [ESI+EAX] (first byte of the 8-byte entry) and compared to S6; on match the function returns EAX = cursor value of the START of the matching entry; on no match it returns EAX = S2 (MOV EAX,EDI @0x00745AFA, EDI never written after load @0x00745A7f - MOV EDI,EDI @0x00745A8E is a self-move with no effect).

Remaining-count dispatch verified by enumeration: residual count 0 -> all three JZ fail -> JNZ 0x00745AFA (S2 returned); 1 -> JZ 0x00745AF2 single check; 2 -> JZ 0x00745AE7 two checks chained; 3 -> fall-through three checks at 0x00745ADC/0x00745AE7/0x00745AF2.

claims.statement: The ONLY match criterion in-window is a single byte: zero-extended byte (0..255) vs S6 as a full DWORD. Because MOVZX results are <=255, S6 with any nonzero byte above bit 7 can NEVER match (CMP EBX,EDX unequal for all entries) - the usable key space is exactly the 256 values of S6's low byte. No in-window immediate equals 20006 (0x4E26), 6, or 2; the immediates present in the window are only 0x4, 0x18, 0x14, 0x5, 0x8, 0x3, 0x1.
premises: CMP with equal operands sets ZF=1 only on exact 32-bit equality
claims.countermodel: a runtime value of S6 could still BE 6, 4 or any byte at the 0x00745C28 callsite - the claim excludes constant/structural presence of 20006/6/2, not their runtime delivery via S6 (caller-side, out of window). If S6 were ever 20006 at the callsite the scan would be a guaranteed always-fail returning S2 - a falsifiable caller-side implication handed to the parent.

claims.statement: The caller's 4-DWORD key (P07-cited: incl. constant 4) is NOT consumed as a composite 4-DWORD match key by 0x00745A70. Consequently the id2/class-20006-tag-6 property hypothesis, insofar as it requires this callee to match a multi-field composite key (id2 + class 20006 + tag 6), does NOT hold at the 0x00745A70 level.

answers_to_package_question.what_key_does_it_match: A single byte value: slot S6 (=[ESP_entry+0x18]) compared as a full DWORD against the zero-extended FIRST byte of each 8-byte entry. Usable key space = S6's low byte (0..255); S6 values >255 can never match (always-fail, returns S2). It does NOT match the caller's 4-DWORD key as a composite - see P10-4/P10-5.
answers_to_package_question.entry_structure_walked_returned: Linear (non-hashed, non-tree) array of 8-byte entries in [S1,S2) addressed as [S4+cursor], cursor = S1,S1+8,...; byte 0 = compared tag; bytes 1..7 unread in-window. Main scan unrolled 4-per-iteration over 0x20-byte blocks; residual handles 1/2/3 entries; returns cursor (start of matching entry) on match, S2 (end) on fail - std::find-shaped contract, caller-distinguishable by comparison to S2.
answers_to_package_question.id2_class_20006_tag_6_hypothesis_verdict: Does NOT survive at the 0x00745A70 level as a composite-key property lookup: REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE in-window (single-byte match only; no 20006/6/2 immediates; 20006 as a match value would be degenerate always-fail). Weaker caller-side variant (caller selects the tag byte and/or interprets entry payload as id2/class/tag data) is NOT_ESTABLISHED here and moves to the 745BF0 window edge.
answers_to_package_question.vfs_record_fed_source_visible: NO - scoped negative with window bounds (P10-7): 0 calls, no global/static data addresses, no I/O in-window. The array populator is out of window; FAMILY-P/T merge question remains NOT_DECIDABLE at this level; deciding evidence = writer of the [this+4]/[this+8]-bounded array.
